generic_interface_spec_c:
### Environment Action Interface & Usage Examples:
ScienceWorld actions follow standard grammatical templates:
- Navigation: 'teleport to <room>' (e.g., 'teleport to kitchen', 'teleport to workshop')
- Perception: 'focus on <object>' (e.g., 'focus on substance'), 'look around'
- Manipulation: 'pick up <object>', 'drop <object>'
- Movement: 'move <object> to <container>' (e.g., 'move apple to red box', 'move fork to table')
- Interaction: 'open <container>', 'close <container>', 'activate <device>'
- Connections: 'connect <object1> to <object2>' (e.g., 'connect wire to battery')
Select exactly one valid action from the provided candidates list.
